tools.name: end_of_service
tools.description: Compute the end-of-service gratuity (UAE Art. 51: 21 days' basic wage per year for 5 years then 30, capped at 2 years' wage, pro rata, unpaid days excluded) or the Saudi award (Art. 84/85/87: half a month's actual wage per year for 5 years then a full month, resignation fractions ⅓/⅔/full). Returns

tools.name: annual_leave_entitlement
tools.description: Accrued annual leave at a date (UAE Art. 29: 30 days/year, 2 days/month between 6 and 12 months; Saudi Art. 109: 21 days, 30 after 5 years), balance after days taken, and encashment value at the legal basis wage. Example: country 'AE', start_date '2024-01-15', as_of_date '2026-10-31', taken_days 20,

tools.name: notice_period
tools.description: Legal notice period for a termination (UAE Art. 43: 30–90 days as agreed; probation Art. 9: 14 days employer / 30 or 14 days employee; Saudi Art. 75: 60 days employer, 30 days employee from 19 Feb 2025), the date notice ends, and pay in lieu. Example: country 'SA', party 'employee', on_date '2026-11

tools.name: overtime_pay
tools.description: Overtime at the legal uplift on the basic hourly wage (UAE Art. 19: +25%, +50% at night 22:00–04:00 or on the rest day; Saudi Art. 107: +50%). Example: country 'AE', basic_monthly_wage 6000, hours 10, kind 'night'.  Response: result with legal_basis (article) and explanation[] steps, data_confidence

tools.name: sick_leave_pay
tools.description: Pay for a number of sick days under the tiered rules (UAE Art. 31: 15 full, 30 half, 45 unpaid, none during probation; Saudi Art. 117: 30 full, 60 at 75%, 30 unpaid). Example: country 'AE', days 40, monthly_wage 9000.  Response: result with legal_basis (article) and explanation[] steps, data_confide

tools.name: probation_rules
tools.description: Probation length allowed (UAE Art. 9: up to 6 months; Saudi Art. 53: up to 180 days from 19 Feb 2025, 90 before), its end date and the notice rules that apply inside it. Example: country 'AE', start_date '2026-11-01', agreed_days 90.  Response: result with legal_basis (article) and explanation[] ste

tools.name: wage_breakdown
tools.description: Daily and hourly basic/total wages under the country's convention (monthly ÷ 30, ÷ 8 hours) with a note on which basis each entitlement uses.
